verdict.rationale: Fastmail is an email product with a webmail inbox, so asking whether that inbox also handles SMS, WhatsApp, social or live chat is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack covers only email, calendar, JMAP, aliases and related features, with no mention of any non-email messaging channel in the inbox.

support.subject: As a team-lead, the same inbox also handles adjacent customer channels — SMS, WhatsApp, social, or live chat — beside email
